note: Plugin-local copy of this repo's measured per-record rates (D-07/D-09). The values, dates and citations below are LITERALS copied in at implementation time from scripts/enrichment_cost_ledger.py's ESTIMATES table, the Phase 22 canary ledger and the Lusha v3 contract. Nothing in the plugin reads those paths at runtime: a runtime coupling to a planning path has already broken once in this repo. A `value` of null means the figure is genuinely unknown and must never be rendered as zero; a `value` of 0 is a real measured zero. Those two are different answers.

lusha_contacts_first_time_enrich.citation: Lusha v3 contract sections 7-8. The 2026-07-30 probe billed 1 credit on a search-and-enrich call that sent NO reveal key at all (scripts/probe_lusha_v3.py's P1/T2b steps sent {"contacts": [identity]} only); the shipped backend always sends a non-empty reveal. n8n execution 12372 (2026-09-11), the Lusha Enrich node's own billing block, is the first measurement of a first-time call with a real reveal: creditsCharged 7 for one rich reveal (email + phone + mobile + LinkedIn + location + seniority), 0 for a NOT_FOUND row, balance 3860 -> 3853 confirmed by scripts/check_provider_credits.py before/after. 7 is the worst case observed to date and is quoted here as a ceiling, not an invoice.
lusha_contacts_first_time_enrich.confidence: measured worst case observed to date (n8n execution 12372, 2026-09-11) — a ceiling, not a flat per-contact price

apollo_per_match.citation: No committed figure exists for this account. Apollo's usage endpoint (POST /api/v1/usage_stats/api_usage_stats) returns per-endpoint RATE LIMITS — limit/consumed/left_over by day, hour and minute — not a depleting credit pool, so even a successful read yields no per-match credit price. Confirmed live 2026-07-31 (HTTP 200 with the master key).
apollo_per_match.confidence: unknown — Apollo does not expose a per-match credit cost for this account; do not substitute a guess

zoominfo_contact_search.citation: D-12 probe rounds 2-4 (2026-09-18, scripts/probe_provider_discovery.py, 73.1-D12-VERDICT.json), each a live search-by-role call against api.zoominfo.com/gtm/data/v1/contacts/search: balance read 9352 before and 9352 after on every round, a real measured zero, not an absence. This is the search-only ZoomInfo rate; the shipped discovery lane (n8n/code/discoverySearch.js, D-12 ruling 2026-09-18) uses ZoomInfo exclusively for search.

apollo_people_search.citation: D-12 probe rounds 2-4 (2026-09-18, scripts/probe_provider_discovery.py, 73.1-D12-VERDICT.json) confirmed the endpoint exists (POST /api/v1/mixed_people/api_search, 200, people returned) but this account's balance is UNREADABLE on it -- per this table's existing apollo_per_match citation, Apollo's usage endpoint returns per-endpoint rate limits rather than a depleting credit pool, and the separate provider credit-check endpoint used elsewhere in this repo returns 403 for this account's (non-master) key -- so this search rate can only ever be priced from vendor documentation, never from a before/after balance read. Operator ruling 2026-09-18 (D-12): 'search-only: ZoomInfo retained, Apollo/Lusha dropped for search phase, full waterfall only used on enrich' -- Apollo is no longer part of the shipped discovery lane; this figure is retained as unmeasured evidence only, never scaled or guessed.
apollo_people_search.confidence: unknown -- Apollo's balance cannot be read on this account; do not substitute a guess. Apollo is no longer used for search in the shipped lane (D-12 ruling).

lusha_prospecting_search.citation: D-12 probe rounds 2-4 (2026-09-18, scripts/probe_provider_discovery.py, 73.1-D12-VERDICT.json), each a live search-by-role call against api.lusha.com/prospecting/contact/search: CROSS-RUN balance 3615 (before round 2) -> 3614 (before round 3) -> 3613 (before round 4), one credit charged per REQUEST even when the round returned zero results -- the charge lands after the response is returned, so each round's own before/after delta reads 0 while the cross-run balance shows the real cost. Operator ruling 2026-09-18 (D-12): 'search-only: ZoomInfo retained, Apollo/Lusha dropped for search phase, full waterfall only used on enrich' -- Lusha is no longer part of the shipped discovery lane; this figure is retained as measured evidence only, in case a future ruling revisits it.
lusha_prospecting_search.confidence: measured -- Lusha is no longer used for search in the shipped lane (D-12 ruling); this rate is not disclosed in the discovery round's cost line.
